plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.map: Resolve Map through the pinned build-70450 catalog and available-section readers. The v23 identity commits to ordered range/status/authentication facts, including ordered zero-length ranges, exact bytes for non-empty available ranges, declared and available counts, decoded section facts, and separate terrain- and VMap-reader materialized row counts. Terrain materialization applies its WDT-zero filter while VMap retains those rows, so these counts may differ. This is an available-source snapshot, not a whole-file Map SHA or complete global Map coverage claim. Unknown or unavailable ranges retain their state and are not represented by invented bytes.
source_policy.liquid_type: Resolve LiquidType through the pinned build-70450 catalog, require a complete bounded source read, and bind its complete raw bytes by SHA-256 and source facts. This v23 runner does not request LiquidMaterial or LiquidObject; those tables remain in the already-produced terrain/VMap profiles' own provenance scopes.
source_policy.terrain_input: Require a freshly verified sealed build-70450 v20 terrain package and canonical producer plan. Its coverage must enumerate every map in the fresh Map active-ancestor closure. Each map must report WDT loaded, known-present tile count known, converted count equal to known-present count, and zero missing root ADTs. A genuinely loaded WDT with known-present zero is a valid empty inventory; unknown, unavailable, or incomplete terrain coverage is rejected before navigation output begins.
source_policy.vmap_input: Require a freshly verified sealed build-70450 v22 VMap package and canonical producer plan. Its selected map, active-ancestor closure, Map source facts, WDT identifiers, effective parent/depth facts, and producer-reported output inventory must match the fresh v23 input facts. v22's declared geometry omissions and scope remain intact; this check does not claim complete geometry.
source_policy.linked_contexts: The v20 and v22 package Context.source_sha256 values must each equal the current LocalStore content identity, and the contexts must agree on build and locale with the v23 plan. Producer and plan hashes of the two inputs may differ; both canonical plans are separately hashed and bound.
source_policy.identity: Inner source-identity grammar version 2 uses a separate versioned, domain-separated digest in v23 Context.source_sha256. It binds the selected map, build, locale, v23 plan and producer identities, Map available-snapshot commitment, both Map reader materialization counts, complete LiquidType source digest, closure and terrain facts, and both verified upstream package identities/plans/inventories/coverage digests. The generic Context type has no publication-profile field; v23 profile enforcement is performed by the canonical Plan, publication dispatch, and v23 coverage verifier.
source_policy.locking_and_finalization: The two input packages are prevalidated and then revalidated under nested read locks. The selected-navigation runner is invoked exactly once from the innermost verified-coverage callback while both locks remain held. The output component is not sealed until both package verifiers finish postchecks, the owner closes with its guards, source Map and LiquidType are reread and compared, and plan/store guards pass. Writes are provisional on any outer failure; this lifecycle is not an atomic multi-package snapshot guarantee.
source_policy.input_path_safety: Input package roots must be distinct and non-overlapping. The output must not equal, contain, or be contained by either input package or producer-plan path. Paths are checked through canonical existing roots and symlink-resistant guards before output mutation.

package.empty_tile: empty outcome is recorded in coverage; no tile file is forced
package.inventory: exactly one v23 coverage file, one selected-map global file, and one tile artifact for each non-empty candidate tile selected from the terrain/VMap input inventory

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, MMap framing, exact selected-map inventory, and canonical stored v23 provenance; no client reads
verification.verify_links_scope: offline verification of both supplied v20 and v22 package/plan pairs followed by exact comparison to the v23 stored linked identities and source/coverage facts; no client reads

coverage.authentication: producer_reported; canonical digests and package self-consistency are verified offline
facts: one selected map, active ancestor closure, roots, effective parent/depth and output roles

Map available-range commitment, including ordered zero-length range facts, authentication facts, available bytes, decoded section facts, separate terrain/VMap materialized row counts and declared partial-source scope
complete raw LiquidType source SHA-256 and bounded record/copy counts
linked v20 terrain and v22 VMap Contexts, canonical producer-plan hashes, exact package file/byte totals, artifact inventory digests, and coverage digests
v20 loaded-WDT and known-present/converted/missing-root-ADT facts for every map in the active closure
one selected navigation global output and exact per-candidate-tile written or empty outcomes, byte counts and SHA-256 values
runner-reported map/tile completion and exposed builder/save/metadata counters

limits.kernel_limits: The filesystem available-owner, selected-navigation pipeline, MMap framing/parser and common package lifecycle also retain their own pinned per-domain default limits.
limits.meaning: Limits are per named input or operation and remain downward-only. The implementation exposes no global cross-stage memory ledger or RSS ceiling; these values must not be summed or presented as a process-memory guarantee. Failure is closed and does not seal the navigation component.

resume: Resume reruns the same v23 selected-map producer with the same canonical v23 plan and both verified input package/plan pairs. Existing package state and sealed-component rules remain those of the shared package lifecycle. Offline verification remains available without client input.

acceptance_matrix.expect: accept one build-70450 mask-32 Linux plan with exactly one canonical map selector and empty DB2 output entries
reject before client or output access
reject; keys and off-mesh are disabled and resident v23 does not accept scratch
reject wrong profile, producer-plan digest, source identity, build, locale, or component before output mutation
reject missing closure map, unloaded WDT, unknown tile inventory, conversion mismatch, or missing root ADT

reject equal, ancestor, descendant, aliased, or symlink-overlapping input/output paths before writes
invoke runner once only after both locked preflights match; callback repetition or either verifier postcheck failure leaves output unsealed
reject post-run Map or LiquidType reread mismatch before component seal
retain each owner-reported empty candidate outcome in coverage without inventing a tile artifact
verify v23 package integrity and exact output inventory without client reads
require both verified upstream package/plan pairs and compare linked identities without client reads
reject; v20-v22 behavior and contracts remain unchanged

excluded: terrain or VMap generation inside the v23 operation
current-client reread during offline verify or verify-links
global process RSS or cross-stage memory guarantee
legacy_preservation: v20 terrain, v21 navigation, and v22 selected geometry keep their existing plan, publication, source-coverage and verification identities; v23 acceptance is additive and transfers no earlier acceptance.
